name: Hayes with Nørbak & CRAVO
description: For serious electronic music fans, Gare hosts a night of hard-hitting techno with local and international talent.
longDescription:
Gare Porto presents a night of techno on May 2, 2026, featuring Hayes, Nørbak, and CRAVO. Hayes, an international artist, is known for their contributions to the contemporary techno scene. Nørbak and CRAVO represent local talent, bringing their distinct sounds to the lineup. The event focuses on showcasing both established and emerging artists within the electronic music genre.

Attendees can expect an evening dedicated to intense electronic music within the industrial setting of Gare Porto. The venue is known for its robust sound system and dark, immersive atmosphere, catering to an audience specifically interested in underground electronic music. The event is designed for serious fans of the genre, providing an extended night of DJ sets.

This is a ticketed event. Gare Porto is located near the Campanhã transport hub, accessible by metro (Campanhã station, 10-minute walk), train, and various bus lines. Specific accessibility information for the venue is not provided. The event is categorized as nightlife and is not suitable for families.
